requestedIntent: Stop ACEF work when active-run status, ledger/context identity, story, or worker-scope runId drift, while keeping one shared decision predicate across status, next-action projection, guards, hooks, and pre-commit.

docs: CHANGELOG.md#Run authorization and bounded review loops

limitations: Worker-scope runId is optional in the schema so existing installed state can still be parsed, but runtime write authorization and pre-commit reject missing bindings until acef-state worker-scope regenerates the scope.
This is cooperative local enforcement and does not cryptographically protect state files from a malicious process with repository write access.
Target repositories must refresh ACEF tools and hooks before they consume this predicate.

evidence.note: Covers valid, blocked, stale-runId, direct-mode authorization and enforces a 50 ms p95 local budget.
Covers CLI validation plus hard-wall rejection of blocked and stale run state.
